title: Riding lawnmower flipping on Facebook Marketplace
one_liner: Agent-run FBMP deal desk: find broken/used riding mowers, score repair economics, draft listings; Brandon buys/repairs/ships.
why_agent_runnable: Deal sourcing, comps, parts lists, listing copy/photos drafts, and CRM are agent-native. Brandon only approves buys, does/owns physical repair or hire, and publishes listings.

ops_steps.title: Geo + brand demand map
ops_steps.detail: Scrape public FBMP/eBay sold comps for riding mower brands in Brandon's metro + export demand notes. Rank brands by spread vs typical repair cost.

ops_steps.title: Brandon sets buy box
ops_steps.detail: Approve max buy price, preferred brands, radius, repair skill vs hire mechanic.

ops_steps.title: Daily deal desk
ops_steps.detail: Monitor FBMP alerts; score deals vs buy box; draft offer messages — no send without Brandon.

ops_steps.title: Purchase approval
ops_steps.detail: Approve each buy (money gate); handle pickup/identity/payment in person or hire.

ops_steps.title: Repair plan + parts cart
ops_steps.detail: Diagnose from photos/manuals; draft parts list and mechanic SOW. Brandon approves parts spend / hire.

ops_steps.title: Listing pack
ops_steps.detail: Draft FBMP/eBay title, description, photo shot list, price ladder. Stay draft until publish gate.

ops_steps.title: Publish + negotiate
ops_steps.detail: Publish listing; agent drafts replies; Brandon sends and closes sale/delivery.

human_only_checkpoints: Any purchase, deposit, ad spend, or paid tool upgrade
Hiring contractors, VAs, or licensed trades
Publishing listings, sites, ads, social as official
Physical pickup, delivery, install, or on-site work

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs/Craigslist job posts, contractor shortlists, SOWs, and payment memos in plan drafts only.
brandon_gates_before_money: approve recurring retainer or inventory buy

unit_economics_sketch.gross_spread_notes: Spread depends on brand, condition, and local demand. Export path optional and adds shipping/legal complexity. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
unit_economics_sketch.disclaimer: No income guarantees. Creator anecdotes ≠ your results.

first_7_day_agent_sprint: Day 1: comps + brand demand map for metro
Day 2: Brandon buy-box + radius + repair vs hire decision
Day 3-4: deal desk live; 20+ scored listings; draft offers only
Day 5: Brandon first purchase gate (or kill if no deal in box)
Day 7: listing pack draft ready for publish gate
kill_criteria: No units inside buy box after 14 days of monitoring
Two consecutive flips lose money after parts+labor+fees
Cannot secure reliable mechanic if Brandon will not DIY
Brandon declines further inventory spend at money gate
disclaimer: Research plan only. Not financial, legal, or investment advice. No income guarantees. Brandon approval required before money, hire, pay, publish, or send.
